description: Exact return shape of SigData.genBeat(n) in assets/engine.js. Every field is always present on archive records (JAH-BEAT-%07d). All beats are original Signature compositions; 'vintage-era' records are original beats IN THE STYLE OF classic eras, never copies of any real song.

bpm.description: Era records: within the era's bpm window (e.g. 150-179 for 50s-rocknroll). Non-era: 70-139.

desc.description: States the beat is an ORIGINAL Signature beat, the style note / genre, the BPM, and that the same request always makes this beat.

era.description: True when the style is a BEAT_ERAS vintage-era style key.

id.description: Permanent ID. Never reused. Reproducible seed is n.

n.description: Deterministic seed. genBeat uses rngFrom('beatrec:' + n).

name.description: Form: 'Signature <adjective> <style words> Beat <I..V>'. E.g. 'Signature Neon hip hop Beat III'.

style.description: Archive values: one of the 6 BEAT_ERAS keys (rng() < 0.45) or one of the 12 SigSynth.GENRES. 'Type beat' style-reference names (STYLE_REFS) are request-time inputs only and never appear here.

title: Signature Music Studio — Beat record
